name: Spiritual Agony
body:
School enchantment [pain]; Level adept 4, cleric/oracle 4, inquisitor 4, lathspell 3, occultist 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser spiritual agony except the damage is increased to 1d6 nonlethal per caster level (maximum 15d6) and the target is nauseated for 1d6 rounds, then sickened for 1 minute thereafter. A successful save halves the damage and reduces the effect to sickened for 1 minute.
